# Branch Mathematics / GURF

Canonical public technical reference.

Core pages:
- /branch-mathematics.html — frozen Version 1 architecture
- /gurf.html — response-specialized layer
- /steadman.html — Steadman model, V1.1 hypothesis freeze and October continuation
- /yang-mills.html — 24 exact finite-lattice SU(2) gap certificates, proof scope, and full review bundle
- /theorems.html — T01-T55, W01-W35, FI01-FI42 registry
- /research.html — active programs and explicit open boundaries
- /encyclopedia.html — terminology
- /calculator.html — paste-first symbolic calculator; advanced exact finite BM checker and Yang–Mills certificate explorer

Status discipline: proved, conditional, open/conjecture, failure. The site does not claim a completed Navier–Stokes Clay proof, continuum Yang–Mills mass-gap proof, universal RD conservation law, or a new fundamental Efficiency Force.

Updated 2026-10-09. The multi-plaquette calculation covers a square, strip, 2×2 patch, and cube at six fixed couplings. Exact omitted-sector control is supplied. All reported energies are in units of c_K. These results do not extend a volume-uniform theorem or establish a continuum theory. Frozen BM definitions and theorem identifiers are unchanged.
